title.en: Would you recognize a hungry classmate?

A2.text: Have you ever seen a hungry classmate here at your own university? No, not really. But would you know one if you saw them?
A2.authored_by: Claude (English teacher role); Gemini 3.1 Pro draft unavailable (API quota exhausted), authored directly
A2.basis: New mission, no workbook source. Researched via WebSearch (Sep 2026). Key facts: Taiwan relative poverty rate ~6.75-7.53% 2017-2023, 7.43% in 2022 (MOHW); low-income children (0-18) fell 117,012 (2016) to 90,245 (2021), near-poor children fell 135,819 (2016) to 107,010 (2021), together ~200,000 in 2021 (MOHW/CRC 兒少統計專區); Child Welfare League Foundation (兒福聯盟) survey: 20% of disadvantaged children have gone hungry at home and eaten snacks instead of a meal; ~20% rely on snacks when school lunch stops over long holidays; 11.0% of students skip breakfast 3+ days/week and arrive hungry; school lunch policy expanding city by city: Taipei free for all public+private elem/JHS since Sept 2025 (NT$87/NT$92 per meal); Kaohsiung free from 2026 school year (~NT$1.8B/yr, ~180,000 students); Tainan (~NT$56/meal) and Chiayi County (~NT$62/meal) free from 2026; Pingtung County free from 2026; Hsinchu City partial subsidy (NT$40/NT$45) with full waiver for disadvantaged (city government press releases, CNA, 風傳媒, 造咖); 2026 revision of 財政收支劃分法 ended central subsidy for domestic school-lunch ingredients, shifting cost to local budgets; Alliance of Taiwan Foodbanks (台灣食物銀行聯合會, ATF) — ~60 member food banks, ~300 partner NPOs, ~100 community refrigerators (84 fridges+16 freezers) nationwide, Taipei flagship store rescues ~20,000 kg food/yr for 200+ households/month, Hualien warehouse stores 500+ tonnes serving 20+ remote communities/schools (atf.tw); retail food waste — supermarkets/hypermarkets declared ~69,670 tonnes discarded Mar 2017-Jun 2023 (6 yrs), ~11,000 tonnes/yr, ~30 tonnes/day (foodnext.net/食力, government-mandated reporting).
